sec-bot: :rotating_light: git-secrets scan on main detected potential secret in repository 'platform-sdk', commit abc1234
sec-bot: Matching pattern: 'AIza[0-9A-Za-z-_]{35}' in file integrations/gcp/ci-helpers.sh
Maya (SecEng): Can someone confirm if that's an actual GCP API key or a false positive? path + commit hash above.
Jared (Infra): Pulling the blob now, will check key age and which SA it maps to.
Jared (Infra): quick grep shows this was added in 2023-10-09 by user 'dev-bot' during chore/ci-update
Priya - DevEx: That script is used in some legacy GH Actions workflows, not mounted anywhere in Dedicated.
Sam Ops: If it's an active key we should rotate immediately. Do we have usage logs? :eyes:
Jared (Infra): Checking Cloud Audit Logs for that key pattern... one second.
Jared (Infra): Found usage: 2024-05-02 03:12 UTC from IP 34.72.11.8 calling service compute.googleapis.com -> created an instance.
Maya (SecEng): :rotating_light: Treat as confirmed exposed creds. Action plan: 1) Revoke key, 2) rotate any associated SA keys, 3) search all repos and CI artifacts for occurrences, 4) update CI to use Secret Manager + KMS, 5) postmortem.
Priya - DevEx: Agreed. I'll open a ticket and add a checklist for DevEx to update the GH Actions template.
Sam Ops: Who can run the revoke? I can, but need the SA email and key id. Jared can you get that?
Jared (Infra): Found service account: ci-runner@redwood-infer-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, key id: 0123456789abcdef
Jared (Infra): Revoke command (gcloud):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete 0123456789abcdef --iam-account=ci-runner@redwood-infer-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Jared (Infra): Also list keys: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ci-runner@redwood-infer-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
Maya (SecEng): Sam, please run the delete and confirm. Also create a short-lived replacement key and store it in Secret Manager with CMEK (KMS) encryption.
Sam Ops: Deleting now...
Sam Ops: Done. Command returned 200, key removed.
Sam Ops: Creating new key and uploading to Secret Manager...
Sam Ops: New key created and stored in projects/redwood-prod/secrets/ci-runner-key/versions/1 (encrypted with projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/ci-key)
Maya (SecEng): Good. Next: retroactive scan across all repos and CI caches. Priya, can you coordinate a GH enterprise secret scan and also run our internal artifact scanner?
Priya - DevEx: On it. Starting full repo scan with gitleaks and the org-wide GH advanced secret scanning.
Priya - DevEx: Adding a pre-commit hook to platform-sdk and raising PRs to replace inline keys with `secretsmanager` lookups.
gha-runner-bot: Workflow run queued: org/scan-full-repos - 1,200 repos
Jared (Infra): Also we should rotate any long-lived tokens in the org and limit SA scope. I'll propose change: deny compute.instances.create permission to CI SA and use a separate provisioning SA with narrow scope.
Maya (SecEng): +1 to RBAC tightening. Add IAM policy change to the ticket. Also enable KMS audit logs for key usage (Cloud Audit Logs, Data Access) and export to the security project for 90d retention.
Sam Ops: I'll open the support ticket with GCP to get logs exported and enable CMEK audit metrics.
Maya (SecEng): Post-incident actions: - run git filter-repo to purge secret from history where feasible, - rotate/revoke any tokens found, - update onboarding docs to ban inline creds, - add GH Action required secret-scanning job to protected branches, - schedule async postmortem.
Priya - DevEx: Drafting postmortem template now. Will include playbook updates and a short training for new hires.
Maya (SecEng): Can we confirm no production impact? Sam, any alerts triggered?
Sam Ops: No anomalies after revocation. There was only that single create event tied to an ephemeral runner; no database writes.
Maya (SecEng): Great. Please file a short incident report (link it here) and assign owners for each remediation item. I'll run the retro audit and tag any high-risk repos.
Priya - DevEx: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-3921, assigning owners: DevEx (Priya) for CI changes, Infra (Jared) for RBAC, Ops (Sam) for keys/log exports, SecEng (Maya) for postmortem.
Maya (SecEng): Thanks everyone. Quick wins: add org-level secret scanning, rotate SA default keys quarterly, and enforce secrets manager usage in GH Actions via set-policy. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Noted. Added labels: severity=medium, type=secret-exposure, followup=postmortem
Priya - DevEx: I'll push PRs to platform-sdk to remove the inline string and add docs by EOD.
Maya (SecEng): Closing thread here, we'll move remediation to INC-2024-3921 checklist and track in the postmortem doc. If anything new shows up ping me directly. :lock:
